$comment: Anchored source patches applied to data/balatro Lua as it goes into the core pack (CORE_PATCHES in scripts/balatro/build-game-pack.py). The L1 specs load the base game through the same list (lib/balatro/lua/spec/core_patches.lua). data/balatro is the licensed source and stays read-only, so every change to game rules or game text is an entry here: {id, why, path, anchor, replacement}, applied in order. Each anchor must occur exactly once in its file, or the build fails. Code entries keep the line count, so error traces keep their line numbers. Text entries cover every language in data/balatro/localization and keep its formatting codes.

patches.why: WS6: the round-eval row label for MP rows (the comeback bonus). The hook is nil outside multiplayer, so single player takes the vanilla branches. Same line, so line numbers in error traces are unchanged.
patches.anchor: elseif config.name == 'hands' then
patches.replacement: elseif RMH_MP and RMH_MP.eval_row_label and RMH_MP.eval_row_label(config, left_text, scale, num_dollars) then elseif config.name == 'hands' then

patches.why: Balance change (owner): a Gold Seal earns $4 (was $3). The amount lives on the seal prototype, so the payout reads one number.
patches.anchor: Gold =      {order = 1,  discovered = false, set = "Seal"},
patches.replacement: Gold =      {order = 1,  discovered = false, set = "Seal", config = {dollars = 4}},

patches.why: Balance change (owner): a Blue Seal creates its Planet card with a 1 in 2 chance (odds on the prototype, scaled by G.GAME.probabilities.normal like every 1 in N).
patches.anchor: Blue =      {order = 3,  discovered = false, set = "Seal"},
patches.replacement: Blue =      {order = 3,  discovered = false, set = "Seal", config = {odds = 2}},

patches.why: Balance change (owner): Blue Stake (and so every stake above it) no longer removes a discard; the other stake effects are untouched. Same line, so no line number moves.
patches.anchor: if self.GAME.stake >= 5 then self.GAME.starting_params.discards = self.GAME.starting_params.discards - 1 end
patches.replacement: -- rmh balance: Blue Stake no longer removes a discard (vanilla took one from stake 5 up)

patches.why: Balance change (owner): the Blue Seal rolls its own seeded stream ('blue_seal'), only when there is room, so a run stays deterministic per seed and multiplayer peers stay in sync. Same line.
patches.anchor: if self.seal == 'Blue' and #G.consumeables.cards + G.GAME.consumeable_buffer < G.consumeables.config.card_limit then
patches.replacement: if self.seal == 'Blue' and #G.consumeables.cards + G.GAME.consumeable_buffer < G.consumeables.config.card_limit and pseudorandom('blue_seal') < G.GAME.probabilities.normal/G.P_SEALS.Blue.config.odds then

patches.why: Balance change (owner): the Gold Seal payout comes from the prototype ($4). Same line.
patches.anchor: ret = ret +  3
patches.replacement: ret = ret +  G.P_SEALS.Gold.config.dollars

patches.why: Balance change (owner): the Blue Seal tooltip on Trance shows the chance (#1# in #2#). Same line.
patches.anchor: elseif _c.name == 'Trance' then info_queue[#info_queue+1] = {key = 'blue_seal', set = 'Other'}
patches.replacement: elseif _c.name == 'Trance' then info_queue[#info_queue+1] = {key = 'blue_seal', set = 'Other', vars = {''..(G.GAME and G.GAME.probabilities and G.GAME.probabilities.normal or 1), G.P_SEALS.Blue.config.odds}}

patches.why: Balance change (owner): the Blue Seal tooltip on a sealed card (hand, deck view, collection) shows the chance (#1# in #2#). Same line.
patches.anchor: if v == 'blue_seal' then info_queue[#info_queue+1] = {key = 'blue_seal', set = 'Other'} end
patches.replacement: if v == 'blue_seal' then info_queue[#info_queue+1] = {key = 'blue_seal', set = 'Other', vars = {''..(G.GAME and G.GAME.probabilities and G.GAME.probabilities.normal or 1), G.P_SEALS.Blue.config.odds}} end
